doc.description:
Common actuators interface
Also keeps the latest feedback of each actuator (ACT_FEEDBACK: RPM, current, voltage, temperatures, output duty cycle and errors, e.g. from UAVCAN or DShot ESCs). ESC_TELEMETRY sends the latest values of all ESCs in one message (element i of each array is the same ESC) with the age of its telemetry. SERVO_TELEMETRY does the same for the servos (position, speed, force, current, voltage, temperature and errors). The ESCs are the actuators with RPM, output or motor temperature feedback, the servos the other ones with position, speed or force feedback, in the actuator order, or the ones in ACTUATORS_TELEMETRY_ESC_IDX and ACTUATORS_TELEMETRY_SERVO_IDX.

define.name: ACTUATORS_TELEMETRY_ESC_IDX
define.description: Actuator indices of the ESCs in ESC_TELEMETRY, in this order (default: the actuators with ESC feedback)

define.name: ACTUATORS_TELEMETRY_ESC_MAX
define.description: Maximum number of ESCs in ESC_TELEMETRY (17 bytes per ESC)

define.name: ACTUATORS_TELEMETRY_SERVO_IDX
define.description: Actuator indices of the servos in SERVO_TELEMETRY, in this order (default: the actuators with servo feedback)

define.name: ACTUATORS_TELEMETRY_SERVO_MAX
define.description: Maximum number of servos in SERVO_TELEMETRY (17 bytes per servo)
